QuestionLabel: A5. During the past month, how frequently have you watched each of the following TV channels? (Select one per line)
BaseDescription: All respondents. Viewing of Channel A or B defines the exposed group; control respondents watched neither

QuestionLabel: B1. When you think of potato chips, what brands come to mind first? Please list as many as you can think of. (Unaided, coded)
BaseDescription: All respondents; multiple mentions, so answers add to more than 100%

QuestionLabel: B2. Which of the following potato chip brands, if any, have you heard of? (Select all that apply)
B2.a On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate your overall impression of each of the following potato chip brands? (1 = Poor, 10 = Excellent)
BaseDescription: Respondents aware of each brand (B2); the base differs by brand

QuestionLabel: B3. How familiar are you with BrandX potato chips? (Select one)
B4. When you are considering purchasing potato chips, how likely are you to consider BrandX? (Select one)
B5. On a scale of 1 to 10, how likely are you to recommend BrandX potato chips to a friend or family member?
BaseDescription: All respondents; NPS = % promoters (9-10) minus % detractors (1-6)

QuestionLabel: C1. Have you seen or heard any advertisements for BrandX potato chips recently? (Select one)
C2. Where did you see or hear the advertisement? (Select one)
BaseDescription: Exposed respondents who recall BrandX advertising (C1 = Yes)

QuestionLabel: C3. After watching this advertisement, do you recall seeing it before? (Select one)
C4. On a scale of 1 to 5, how much did you enjoy the advertisement you just watched? (Select one)
C5. Please indicate how much you agree or disagree with the following statements about the advertisement. (Select one per line)
C6. In your own words, please describe the main message or key takeaway of the advertisement. (Open-ended, coded into themes)
BaseDescription: Exposed respondents only; a response can carry more than one theme

QuestionLabel: C7. Which of the following do you believe was the main message of the advertisement? (Select one)
